CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55495  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Climate Resilient and Sustainable
  City Commission meeting of Thursday, April 23, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55499  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from City staff on drought and
  the Climate Action Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55500  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55501  Recommendation to receive and file announcements and resources from the
  Office of Climate Action and Sustainability.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT
